correctness.rationale: For P=A⊕B⊕C, equivalence classes under confluence D and U absorb A whenever meeting A,B and absorb C whenever meeting B,C; a class meeting A,C must absorb all three levels by witnesses. In nonuniversal cases, unique lower crossing class L and upper class H, with any residual middle point forced to the opposite crossing class. This yields precisely levelwise partitions, merged A∪B, merged B∪C, opposed A∪U vs (B\U)∪C for nonempty proper U⊂B, and universal. Each pattern directly satisfies the two quantified D/U witnesses. Their disjoint counts give Bell(a)Bell(b)Bell(c)+Bell(a)+Bell(c)+2^b-1 for all a,b,c>=1. Independent full set-partition witness enumeration verified (1,1,1):4, (1,2,1):7, (2,2,1):10, (2,2,2):15 and (1,3,2):20. Finite cases corroborate, not replace, five-pattern proof.
